steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Vina!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Did I fall sleep?

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: You're lucky to be out for just a little bit after your injuries.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Siege, Self-Salvation Corps reinforcements have arrived. This place is relatively safe. Rest well; we'll be at your side.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Mm...
She scans the faces of her friends.
Everyone is bruised and battered, just as she is. But they are alive, and there is still hope in their eyes.
Except...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: ...Allerdale.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: The door to the Mausoleum of Kings has closed once again.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: The Sarkaz have noticed the sound of the Steam Knight, and they must have guessed that the Sighs of Kings has left its home. They're sending men to the palace.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Our scouts have tried to get close to the entrance, but there has been no sign of Allerdale.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Do you want to talk about what happened below?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Just as the warriors imagined.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Allerdale Cumberland sacrificed herself to save us.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Sounds like something Allerdale would do. Cumberland the Ever on High.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Cumberland...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: There's no such thing as Cumberland the Ever on High, Clovisia.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Allerdale protected what she wanted to protect with her life.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Not out of any duty... simply of her own accord.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Her own accord...

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Yes, she was brave.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Shame... I had a surprise for Allerdale when she came back.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: This is...

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: The ducal manor is in ruins, but the scouts found this among the ashes.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The steam armor of House Cumberland.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: It wasn't lost in the fire...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Haha.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: If only she could see this.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Then she would have known that there is no such thing as a fixed path.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The fire had not taken away all the hopes that she placed on the armor.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Clovisia, we saw a Steam Knight in the Mausoleum of Kings.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Maybe the last one.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Four years ago, the Duke's men lured the Steam Knights into the Mausoleum of Kings, where they were ambushed by the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: That passage is the tomb of the Steam Knights.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: What a gruesome scene it must have been, even though I was not there to see it.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: He attacked you, didn't he? He attacked the heir to the throne of Victoria.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: He was just doing his job.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: He's defending the Sighs of Kings, even if it was merely an excuse to lure the Steam Knights into the mausoleum.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: He witnessed comrade after comrade fall, and spent so many years in darkness. The pain must have gnawed away at his sanity.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Words like these are too simple to describe what went through the mind of this warrior.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: On one side, the tombs of the kings. On the other, the bodies of his fellows. He defended the silent resting place for countless days and nights.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: He was no madman or ghost. His will was so strong that it conquered death.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: By his own will, he exacted revenge on a Victoria that betrayed him.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: By his own will, he defended the symbol of Victoria.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I don't know if we'll ever see him again.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: If... if he can escape the darkness...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: May he once again find what he wants to defend.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: We found the mercenaries who went to Highbury, general.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Bring them forward.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Yes, sir.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: *cough* *cough* L-Let me go!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: A mere girl...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: She was found tied up on the streets with her fellow mercenaries.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: I checked her weapons, and there were few signs of use. She hardly even qualifies as a merc.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Is that so?

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Speak, mercenary.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Did you not kill a single Victorian?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: Uwah...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Are you afraid of me?

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: N-No!

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: I-I failed my mission. You can punish me. But l-let the others go!

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Take her back.

steps.name: Paprika
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: General...

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: You said she hardly qualifies as a mercenary.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: Young Sarkaz like her don't understand what we fight for, nor the true face of our enemy, because no one ever taught her.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: The real war is about to begin.

steps.name: Manfred
steps.text: I will show her what this war means to the Sarkaz. She will watch it unfold by my side.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Feist!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Rockrock... ha, Squad 11 of the Self-Salvation Corps, back together again, eh?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: There's only the two of us left from Squad 11.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: But I'm sure we'll grow again.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We have the Doctor and the commander, after all.

options: How is the Corps faring, Clovisia?

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: The retreat was initiated on-time, but we suffered heavy casualties.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: And we're facing a supply shortage after Allerdale went missing.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: If only we had more hands...

steps.name: Victorian Mercenary
steps.text: You've got a few here.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Totter?

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: My employer has gone missing, so my contract is now null and void.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Are you sure you want to stay?

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: We're already here. Hard to get out when you're on the wrong side of the Sarkaz anyway.

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: And we fought alongside Dagda's group in the mausoleum.

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: I may not have made it out alive, if not for them.

steps.name: Totter
steps.text: Another debt... I guess I need to push my retirement back.

steps.name: Misery
steps.text: Doctor, we're here.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Sorry. I wished we'd moved quicker and helped you at the command tower.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: And you are...?

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Horn, leader of the 2nd squad of the Tempest Platoon of Victoria.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: Misery helped us break into a prison at the border of Auchterigg and Highbury a few hours ago.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: We rescued a Defense Force patrol that was about to be executed for refusing to fight for the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Horn
steps.text: We'll be operating with Rhodes Island and the Self-Salvation Corps from this point on.

options: Looks like we have some new friends, Clovisia.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Thank you, everyone.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: It's a pleasant surprise, one that has opened up many possibilities.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Although we took heavy losses, we did manage to obtain important information about the Sarkaz supply lines.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Commander, Doctor, here's the intel on potential depots in Highbury.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Add to that the data that Closure obtained from the command tower...

options: We'll be able to locate the supply line.
The hint to our next step lies within this intel.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Clovisia
steps.text: We'll make preparations for the battles ahead.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Kyngasycath, the Sighs of Kings.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I know you're there, Gawain.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Show yourself.
There is no one around her.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: ...Duty.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You've been with me all this time. What is the duty that you've chosen for me?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: To put a king on the throne of Victoria again?
Silence.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Allerdale... she aspired to be a Steam Knight, yet...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We can't always know what we're heading towards.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: If, one day—

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: If, one day I strayed from the destiny that you chose for me.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Would you become my nightmare?
The only sound in the underground space is a quiet sigh.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: ...Serious.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: But Shining is here. She'll recover.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: If the Banshee Lord and I arrived in time...

options: We got away only because you slowed the 'Red-Eye'.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: She's recovering. You can see it. She won't let herself sleep for too long.

options: I didn't see what she saw.
I'm never there with her when I should be.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: You've always cared a lot about Amiya. All the versions of you.

options: I never had a chance to ask.
Did you suspect that I was pretending to have amnesia?

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: My dagger will answer that question.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: ...When necessary.

options: I want to know the truth of what happened four years ago.
But I don't know what's true and what's not.
I hardly ever get a chance to sit down and talk to you.
Can you tell me what you saw?

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Four years ago, you sent me on a mission away from the landship.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Her Majesty had left us by the time I returned.

options: What was the situation at Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Rhodes Island had to escape before Theresis's army surrounded us.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: Amiya was in a coma after inheriting the King of Sarkaz's powers.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: She wanted to save Rhodes Island, save Amiya, and save you.

steps.name: Ascalon
steps.text: It was Her Majesty's final order.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Doctor... Doctor... Dr. {@nickname}...
Amiya grabs your clothing subconsciously, then slowly loosens her grip.
Tears flow from her eyes.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Theresa...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: She showed me the voices of the Sarkaz souls.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They wanted to take revenge on everyone who has wronged the Sarkaz. They wanted to take revenge on Dr. Kal'tsit.

options: What does this have to do with her?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...I believe that everything I felt was real, Doctor.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I remember how Dr. Kal'tsit and Theresa spent many nights talking at Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I remember how Dr. Kal'tsit went a whole week without sleeping to save a group of Sarkaz Infected.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But it's true that she wronged the Sarkaz, two hundred years ago...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Dr. Kal'tsit must have told Theresa why she did it at the time.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: And Theresa must have accepted it, which was why they became such good friends.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: But even I... even I, who knows Dr. Kal'tsit so well...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I felt anger and sorrow when I felt the memories of the war.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Maybe that's what Theresa wanted to tell me.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Theresa wanted to tell me why she sided with the souls of the Sarkaz.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: They are there... above Londinium.
The sound of thunder approaches.
It is outside the window, above your heads, never far away.
You hold Amiya's hand.
The two of you look up at the sky together.
Rumble. Rumble. Rumble.
Even the nearby cities feel the vibration, not just Londinium.
A massive object, the likes of which has never been seen before, rises up from the dark clouds.
Behind it, the thick clouds atop The Shard finally crack open. Those who have raised their heads to look up finally realize it was no ordinary cloud that surrounded Londinium.
It was a Catastrophe cloud, far more massive than what any Catastrophe Messenger has ever recorded.
Sparks fly out of the overcharged black clouds, rumbling like thunder.
The strange flying machine is like the eye of the storm.
Beneath its gaze, there is nowhere for the enemies of the Sarkaz to run.
2:28 P.M. / Overcast
Tradersmill City, Victoria

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Chenchen!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: What're you daydreamin' about? Hughes is waitin' for us. Sounds like he got a really solid lead.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The one who just left Hughes's house...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Look at this crowd. Who are you talking about?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: The green-haired Feline.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: I think I've seen her before.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Well, you've got a better memory for faces than I do. Maybe she was there to talk business with Hughes? Did you see her at the station a few days ago?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's a memory from many years ago.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Not a criminal you caught in Lungmen, is she?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If that was it, I wouldn't have forgotten.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Never mind. We can just ask Hughes.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: ...Bagpipe.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: I've seen the other in the intel too.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Hehe...

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: We almost had a touching reunion.
Victoria South Office

steps.name: Reed
steps.text: Hello.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: You're... I've seen you in the sickbay at HQ, haven't I?

steps.name: Reed
steps.text: There's something I would like to ask of you.

steps.name: Reed
steps.text: Please give this letter to Dr. Kal'tsit and Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: You... ahem. Are you planning to leave the office?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: You should submit an application, like the other evacuating operators. Just so that HR is on top of things, you know...

steps.name: Reed
steps.text: They know.

steps.name: Reed
steps.text: They know there's something I have to do.

steps.name: Reed
steps.text: I'll only bring danger to the rest of you, if I stay here.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: You want to protect Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Reed
steps.text: Rhodes Island... is a quiet place.

steps.name: Reed
steps.text: I like it here, and I'm thankful to you. Especially the Sankta who left us... you've given me the peace that I always sought.

steps.name: Reed
steps.text: And now, I repay this peace.

steps.name: Reed
steps.text: I'm ready.

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: The Sarkaz airship has taken off within Londinium.

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: The heir to the Duchy of Cumberland is missing. The Duke of Caster did not obtain the Sighs of Kings.

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: A dozen Messengers have visited your demesne in a single day.

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: They want to know whether you are ready to grant them an audience.

steps.name: Duke of Wellington
steps.text: What do you think, Your Highness... Princess Eblana?
Duke Wellington...
Right before my eyes... I see a new Taran era.
